cause_quote: The new `timestamp: new Date(message.timestamp).toISOString(),` line threw a `RangeError` when a context-engine message had no timestamp.
user_saw: When an agent used a tool and ended its turn without a final answer, a requester could receive an incomplete-turn error instead of the recovered answer.
summary: The fix uses a fixed timestamp for temporary history entries so isolated finalization can trim context-engine messages with missing or invalid timestamps.
reasoning: I checked the parent implementation and its existing finalization test, which expected the tool-free recovery step to return an answer using session history. PR #186288 reports successful finalization on the previous main and shows where it switched to a context-engine snapshot and added the timestamp conversion that made the same recovery path crash before calling the model.
